mapping.editorialFunction: Open the film inside a working life the viewer recognizes, before any question is asked.

mapping.editorialFunction: Make the abstract question about money and traded years feel physical and quiet.

mapping.editorialFunction: Leave the third question open: no exit shown, no answer implied.

mapping.editorialFunction: Provide a quiet visual surface beneath the channel name and episode title; the title layer owns this shot.

mapping.editorialFunction: Establish a workplace where someone is quietly good at what they do.
